### Reshaping the data
```{r}
### Rename all CN_annot names for analysis in R
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("B cell priming zone", "B_cell_priming_zone", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Bulk tumor", "Bulk_tumor", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("CAF-enriched stroma", "CAF_enriched_stroma", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Granulocyte-enriched", "Granulocyte_enriched", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Myeloid-cell enriched immune infiltrate", "Myeloid_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot  <- gsub("Plasma-cell enriched immune infiltrate", "Plasma_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("T cell priming and activation", "Tcell_priming_and_activation", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Tumor boundary", "Tumor_boundary", df$CN_k20_n25_annot )
df$CN_k20_n25_annot <- gsub("Vessel-enriched stroma", "Vessel_enriched_stroma", df$CN_k20_n25_annot)

df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("B lymphocytes", "B_lymphocytes", df$cell_types_lowres )
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("T lymphocytes", "T_lymphocytes", df$cell_types_lowres)
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("other leukocytes", "other_leukocytes", df$cell_types_lowres)
df$cell_types_lowres <- gsub("myeloid cells", "myeloid_cells", df$cell_types_lowres)
```



# Figure 3B: Stacked barplot to show distribution of CNs per tumor sample
```{r}
colors_cn = c("Vessel_enriched_stroma" = 'red',
 "CAF_enriched_stroma" = 'orange',
 'Granulocyte_enriched'= 'cyan',
 'Myeloid_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate'= 'sienna',
 'Tcell_priming_and_activation'= 'lightgreen',
 'B_cell_priming_zone'= 'royalblue',
 'Follicle'= 'blue',
 'Tumor_boundary'= 'grey',
 'Epithelium'= 'magenta',
 'Bulk_tumor'= 'navy',
 'Plasma_cell_enriched_immune_infiltrate'= 'purple'
)



Stacked_barplots_CN_k20_n25 <- df %>% 
  mutate(MCPyV_status_Nolan = factor(MCPyV_status_Nolan, levels = c('positive', 'negative'))) %>% 
  group_by(TMA_core_num, CN_k20_n25, MCPyV_status_Nolan) %>% 
  dplyr::count() %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(TMA_core_num, MCPyV_status_Nolan) %>% 
  mutate(order_vec = ifelse(MCPyV_status_Nolan == 'positive', n[CN_k20_n25 == 'CN0']/sum(n), n[CN_k20_n25 == 'CN9']/sum(n))) %>% 
  #mutate(cell_types_mediumres = reorder_within(cell_types_mediumres, -n, MCPyV_status_Nolan)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(as.factor(TMA_core_num), -order_vec), y = n, fill = CN_k20_n25)) + 
  geom_col(position = 'fill') + 
  facet_grid(~MCPyV_status_Nolan, scales = 'free_x', space = 'free') + 
  scale_fill_manual('CN_k20_n25', values = c("CN1" = 'grey',
    "CN0"= "navy",
    "CN2" = "sienna",
    'CN9'= 'orange',
    "CN3"= "lightgreen",
    "CN4"= "lightblue",
    "CN5"= "royalblue", 
    "CN6"= "purple",
    "CN7"= "cyan",
    "CN8"= "red",
    "CN10"= "magenta"), na.value = 'white') + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = 'none',
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) + 
  labs(x = 'Tumor ID', y = 'Proportion')

Stacked_barplots_CN_k20_n25

output_dir <- "/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/Figures/Figure3/CN_Figure3/"

ggsave(plot = Stacked_barplots_CN_k20_n25, filename = paste0(output_dir, "stacked_barplot_CN_k20_n25_sorted_MCPyV_v2.pdf"), dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 10)
```

# Figure 3C: Waterfall plot to compare CN abundance between viral conditions
```{r}
colors_cn = c("CN8" = 'red',
 "CN9" = 'orange',
 'CN7'= 'cyan',
 'CN2'= 'sienna',
 'CN3'= 'lightgreen',
 'CN4'= 'royalblue',
 'CN5'= 'blue',
 'CN1'= 'grey',
 'CN10'= 'magenta',
 'CN0'= 'navy',
 'CN6'= 'purple'
)

df_filt <- df %>% dplyr::select(cell_types_mediumres, MCPyV_status_Nolan, CN_k20_n25)

CN_k20_n25_log2c <- df_copy %>% 
  group_by(CN_k20_n25, MCPyV_status_Nolan) %>% 
  dplyr::count() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(MCPyV_status_Nolan) %>% 
  mutate(total_n = sum(n)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(CN_k20_n25) %>% 
  mutate(diff = log2((lag(n)/lag(total_n)) / (n/total_n))) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(CN_k20_n25, diff), y = diff, fill = CN_k20_n25)) +
  geom_col() + 
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, ymin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = 'royalblue', alpha = 0.02) + 
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, ymin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymax = 0), fill = 'red', alpha = 0.02) + 
  #annotate('text', x = 2, y = 1.5, label = 'EBV+', size = 12) +
  #annotate('text', x = 13, y = -1, label = 'EBV-', size = 12) +
  labs(x = 'Cellular neighborhoods', y = 'log2fold enrichment', title = 'CN enrichment (MCPyV+/MCPyV-)') + 
  scale_fill_manual('CN', values = colors_cn, na.value = 'white') +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = 'none',
        text = element_text(size = 12))
CN_k20_n25_log2c

  
ggsave('/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/Figures/Figure3/CN_Figure3/CN_log2c_with_all_CNs.pdf', CN_k20_n25_log2c, dpi = 320, width = 10, height = 8)
```

# Figure 3H: Heatmap depicting expression of functional markers in selected CNs
```{r}
library(dplyr)
df_filt_expression <- dplyr::select(df, `PD-L1`, LAG3, `PD-1`, `HLA-DR`, CXCL9, CXCR3, `IL-10`, CXCL10, CXCL13, CN_k20_n25)

mean_expression <- df_filt_expression %>%
  group_by(CN_k20_n25) %>%
  summarize(
    PDL1_mean = mean(`PD-L1`, na.rm = TRUE),
    PD1_mean = mean(`PD-1`, na.rm = TRUE),
    LAG3_mean = mean(LAG3, na.rm = TRUE),
    HLADR_mean = mean(`HLA-DR`, na.rm = TRUE),
    CXCL9_mean = mean(CXCL9, na.rm = TRUE),
    IL10_mean = mean(`IL-10`, na.rm = TRUE),
    #CXCR3_mean = mean(CXCR3, na.rm = TRUE),
    #CXCL10_mean = mean(CXCL10, na.rm = TRUE),
    #CXCL13_mean = mean(CXCL13, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Z-normalize the mean expression values
z_normalized <- mean_expression %>%
  mutate(across(PDL1_mean:IL10_mean, scale))

# Convert to a matrix for the heatmap
z_normalized <- z_normalized %>% dplyr::select(-CN_k20_n25)

z_matrix <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(z_normalized))
rownames(z_matrix) <- mean_expression$CN_k20_n25


ht <- Heatmap(z_matrix,
        row_km = 4,
        column_km = 3, 
        #top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(foo = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = 3:0),
        #labels = c("Naive/memory", "Effector", "EXeff"), 
        #labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = 8))),
        #left_annotation = rowAnnotation(foo = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = 9:7),
        #labels = c("Tem zone", "Tscm reservoir", "Teffex zone", "Tnaive", "Tearlyeff"), 
        #labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = 10))),
        border = TRUE,
        name = "Z-score",
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
        show_row_dend = TRUE,
        show_column_dend = TRUE,
        #right_annotation = rowAnnotation(foo2 = 11:1, bar2 = anno_barplot(runif(11))),
        col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red")))
ht
ht
pdf(file=paste0(output_path, "/Heatmap_immunoregulatory_proteins_invasive_front_all.pdf"), width = 4, height = 7)
 draw(ht)
 dev.off()
 print(ht)
```
